ruleDefinitions.name: Sdiagnhost Calling Suspicious Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects sdiagnhost.exe calling a suspicious child process (e.g. used in exploits for Follina / CVE-2022-30190)

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\sdiagnhost\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\taskkill\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*bits.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\-noprofile\\ \\-$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\-noprofile$"))))
